AnnotateInstruction.description:
Draw a freehand annotation — circle, underline, or arrow.

Annotations are ephemeral teaching gestures: they draw in with organic
animation and fade out after a duration. Used to direct student attention
to elements already on the board.
AnnotateInstruction.title: AnnotateInstruction

BracketInstruction.description: Curly-brace bracket spanning two diagram elements with a centered label.
BracketInstruction.title: BracketInstruction

ClearInstruction.description: Clear the board — all elements or a specific target.
ClearInstruction.title: ClearInstruction

DrawCalloutInstruction.description: Speech-bubble callout from a specific diagram element.
DrawCalloutInstruction.title: DrawCalloutInstruction

DrawDesignDiagramInstruction.description:
Draw a detailed SVG diagram generated by the design agent.

The ``spec`` field carries the full DiagramSpec — a JSON object with
SVG elements, optional interactive parameters, and graph insets.
The frontend renders this as a pure SVG with KaTeX overlays.
DrawDesignDiagramInstruction.title: DrawDesignDiagramInstruction

DrawDiagramInstruction.description:
Draw a structured diagram with nodes and edges.

Either `description` (text fallback for unstructured diagrams) or `nodes`
(structured data for real rendering) must be provided. When both are present,
`nodes` takes precedence and `description` is used as accessible alt-text.
DrawDiagramInstruction.title: DrawDiagramInstruction

DrawSceneInstruction.description:
Draw a scientific diagram from a scene template or semantic spec.

Three content paths (at least one required):
1. ``template`` — hand-tuned scene template (legacy, simple)
2. ``scene_type`` + ``elements`` — composable semantic spec (flexible)
3. ``description`` — text-only fallback
DrawSceneInstruction.title: DrawSceneInstruction

EquationStep.description: A single step in a multi-step equation solve.
EquationStep.title: EquationStep

FunctionDef.description: A mathematical function to plot, e.g. f(x) = x^2 + 2x - 3.
FunctionDef.title: FunctionDef

HighlightInstruction.description:
Highlight an existing element on the board.

When ``sub_element_ids`` is non-empty, highlights specific SVG sub-elements
within the target card (matched via ``data-design-element`` attributes)
instead of the card itself.
HighlightInstruction.title: HighlightInstruction

HighlightPulseInstruction.description: Single-element pulse highlight — one short glow cycle.
HighlightPulseInstruction.title: HighlightPulseInstruction

HighlightWalkInstruction.description:
Speech-synced highlight walk through sub-elements of a diagram or scene.

Each step spotlights a sub-element as the agent speaks its trigger words.
Only one step is highlighted at a time (spotlight semantics).
Auto-cleans up when all steps complete or on timeout.
HighlightWalkInstruction.title: HighlightWalkInstruction

HighlightWalkStep.description:
A single step in a highlight walk — maps a sub-element to trigger words.

``sub_element_id`` is matched against diagram node IDs (``data-node``,
``data-rough-node``) or scene component IDs (``data-scene-path`` prefix).
HighlightWalkStep.title: HighlightWalkStep

NewPageInstruction.description:
Turn to a fresh blank page in the notebook.

``carry_forward_ids`` lets a premise from the previous page show at the
top of the new page as a muted, inert reminder — useful when a starting
equation or key fact still applies after the page turn.
NewPageInstruction.title: NewPageInstruction

Panel.title: Panel

PinLabelInstruction.description:
Place a small text label near a diagram element with a thin connector.

``panel`` is stamped to ``Panel.SLIDE`` by ``_stamp_panel`` at publish time
via ``INSTRUCTION_TYPE_TO_PANEL`` — the model leaves it ``None`` so that
the same stamping contract holds for every instruction type.
PinLabelInstruction.title: PinLabelInstruction

PlacementIntent.description:
Semantic placement intent from the LLM.

The LLM outputs one of:
1. near + relation: place relative to an existing element
2. zone: backward-compatible zone placement
3. Neither: solver picks best position automatically
PlacementIntent.title: PlacementIntent

SceneTemplateId.description: Known scene templates — backend validates against this enum.
SceneTemplateId.title: SceneTemplateId

SceneTemplateRef.description: Reference to a hand-tuned scene template.
SceneTemplateRef.title: SceneTemplateRef

ScrollViewInstruction.description:
Scroll the viewport camera to a tile position on the infinite canvas.

Ephemeral control instruction — not tracked as a board element.
The frontend animates a smooth pan to the target tile.
ScrollViewInstruction.title: ScrollViewInstruction

SemanticSceneElement.description:
A semantic element in a composable scene diagram.

Maps directly to the frontend's SemanticSceneElement interface.
The ``from`` field is a Python reserved word, so it's stored as
``from_ref`` with a Pydantic alias — serialized as ``"from"`` on the wire.
SemanticSceneElement.title: SemanticSceneElement

ShowEquationInstruction.description:
Display a LaTeX equation with optional animation metadata.

The `latex` field may contain \htmlId{id}{content} tags for per-term
animation targeting (used by GSAP in the frontend renderer).
ShowEquationInstruction.title: ShowEquationInstruction

ShowTextInstruction.description: Display text on the classroom screen.
ShowTextInstruction.title: ShowTextInstruction

SlidePendingInstruction.description:
Generation in progress — frontend shows the DraftingLoader.

Emitted before a slow slide-producing tool call (cache-miss path of
`draw_design_diagram`) so the split-board can display the drafting
loader with a title caption while the spec is being generated.
Cleared on the client when a matching `draw_*` instruction arrives
for the same board, or on `switch_board`.
SlidePendingInstruction.title: SlidePendingInstruction

StepEquationInstruction.description:
Display a multi-step equation solve with progressive reveal.

Each step appears with its transformation annotation, changed terms
highlight, and previous steps dim — like a teacher at a whiteboard.
StepEquationInstruction.title: StepEquationInstruction

StrikethroughInstruction.description: Cross out an existing notebook entry identified by element_id.
StrikethroughInstruction.title: StrikethroughInstruction

SwitchBoardInstruction.description:
Switch the active board — sent to frontend for board transitions.

This is a control instruction: it tells the frontend which board to display.
Not tracked as a board element (ephemeral).
SwitchBoardInstruction.title: SwitchBoardInstruction

TermSyncHint.description: Maps a tagged equation term to the spoken words that trigger its reveal.
TermSyncHint.title: TermSyncHint

WriteAnswerInstruction.description: Write the boxed final answer in the notebook — LaTeX or text.
WriteAnswerInstruction.title: WriteAnswerInstruction

WriteEquationInstruction.description:
Write an equation into the notebook's working column.

Equations in the same ``align_group`` render aligned at ``=``.
WriteEquationInstruction.title: WriteEquationInstruction

WriteSectionInstruction.description: Write a section header in the notebook.
WriteSectionInstruction.title: WriteSectionInstruction

WriteStepInstruction.description: Write a numbered or unnumbered working step in the notebook.
WriteStepInstruction.title: WriteStepInstruction

WriteTextInstruction.description: Write a plain text line or a key-point box in the notebook.
WriteTextInstruction.title: WriteTextInstruction
